items.definition:
based on, concerned with, or verifiable by observation or experience rather than theory or pure logic
The study provided strong empirical evidence for the theory.

relating to metabolism
Exercise can boost your metabolic rate.

combative and aggressive in support of a cause
The group adopted a more militant approach.

relating to or denoting a tradition within Protestant Christianity
She belongs to an evangelical church.

extremely beautiful and delicate
The painting was of exquisite beauty.

dishonest, deceitful
The company was accused of fraudulent accounting practices.

based on a hypothesis; supposed
Let's consider a hypothetical situation where we have unlimited resources.

not genuine; fake
He presented a pseudo-scientific theory.

tending to remind one of something
Her style is reminiscent of the 1960s.

relating to or characteristic of suicide
If you are feeling suicidal, please seek help.

of the greatest possible degree; most extreme
We must proceed with the utmost care.

relating to the brain or intellect
The film was very cerebral and made you think deeply.

(of an old person) strong and healthy
Despite his age, he remained hale and hearty.

relating to the theories of Karl Marx
He holds strong Marxist views on economics.

relating to mysteries or spiritual truths
She was drawn to the mystic traditions of the East.

in name only; very small
He was the nominal head of the organization, but others made the decisions.

producing much fruit or foliage or many offspring; producing many works
He was a prolific writer, publishing over 50 novels.

Involving or relating to serious academic study
He published a scholarly article on ancient history.

Giving the impression that something harmful or evil is happening or will happen
There was a sinister atmosphere in the old abandoned house.

Enforcing strict obedience to authority, especially that of the government, at the expense of personal freedom
The country was ruled by an authoritarian regime.

having the qualities of surrealism; bizarre
The dream felt incredibly surreal.

of enormous size, strength, or power
The company faced a titanic struggle to survive.

involving or causing sudden great damage or suffering
The earthquake caused catastrophic damage.

clothed or covered
The knight was clad in shining armor.

(of a person or their behavior) unconventional and slightly strange
My eccentric aunt always wears mismatched socks.

having both electric and magnetic properties
Light is a form of electromagnetic radiation.

serving as a sign or indication of something
His silence was indicative of his disapproval.

feeling or showing caution about possible dangers
She was wary of strangers.

relating to cooking
He attended a prestigious culinary school.

individually separate and distinct
The company has several discrete departments.

famous and respected within a particular sphere or profession
He is an eminent scholar in the field of history.

producing a great deal of profit
He started a lucrative business selling handmade jewelry.

increasing or growing by successive additions
The cumulative effect of these small changes was significant.

artificial; imitation
She wore a coat made of faux fur.

very complicated or detailed
The watch had an intricate design.

flourishing or spreading unchecked
Crime was rampant in the city during that period.

mentioned before
The aforementioned issues need to be addressed.

not openly acknowledged or displayed; secret
The agency conducted a covert operation.

extremely useful; indispensable
His experience was invaluable to the success of the team.

not sufficiently strict, severe, or careful
The security at the event was too lax.

relating to the nervous system
She is studying neurological disorders.

relating to the countryside or to the duties of a pastor
The painting depicted a peaceful pastoral scene.

relating to the normal functions of living organisms
Stress can have significant physiological effects on the body.

relating to earthquakes or other vibrations of the earth
The region is prone to seismic activity.

relating to the sky or heaven
The night sky was filled with celestial bodies.

about to happen; forthcoming
The dark clouds signaled an impending storm.

third in order or level
She is pursuing tertiary education at the university.

not affected by the passage of time
Her classic style is truly timeless.

lacking sophistication or good taste
His language was often vulgar and offensive.

remaining after the greater part has gone or been removed
There was a residual smell of smoke in the room.

nearer the front, especially in the anterior part of the body or a structure
The anterior part of the brain controls movement.

gentle and kind; not harmful in effect
The doctor assured her that the tumor was benign.

Characterized by or holding false beliefs or judgments.
He was so delusional that he believed he could fly.

Having actual being; existing.
The question of whether alien life is existent remains unanswered.

lasting or existing for a long or apparently infinite time; enduring or continually recurring
The perennial problem of traffic congestion affects the city.

relating to or consisting of a procedure
The company is reviewing its procedural guidelines.

oppressively constant; incessant
The team showed relentless determination to win the game.

relating to vessels that convey fluids
The human body has a complex vascular system.

having or showing a dislike of or prejudice against gay people
Homophobic remarks are unacceptable in any workplace.

great in importance, extent, or size
Building the pyramids was a monumental task.

picturesque
The village was very picturesque.

pivotal
This decision was pivotal for the company's future.

pulmonary
She has a pulmonary condition.

having the same meaning
For many people, 'freedom' is synonymous with 'liberty'.
